entities.summary: SRF 1 is a German-language Swiss television channel, one of three produced by the SRG SSR public-service broadcasting group. The channel, formerly known as SF1, was renamed on 16 December 2012, together with its sister German-speaking TV channels and five radio channels, as part of an exercise aimed at emphasizing their common ownership as well as establishing a shared web presence for all of them.
